missions.title: Day Two
missions.desc: Rhalix brings you to meet his new team.

lines.t: Year 100. Day two in the new world for Rhalix Murasaki... and for {you}.
It's your boy Rhalix! Team, say hi - I found someone else to join us.
lines.group: It's your boy Rhalix! Team, say hi - I found a few more people to join us.

lines.t: (Happy) Captain's back! And... hi.
lines.sky: (Happy) Captain's back! Oh - you've got wings too!

lines.t: Yo! Another fighter? Can you beat some heads?
lines.sky: Yo! Another Skylander! Finally, the numbers are on our side.
lines.ground: Yo! A human helping Skylanders? That's cool, for real.

lines.t: Can y'all hop off the captain for five seconds. (cough) Welcome. Don't touch my cigarettes.
lines.sky: (cough) Another Skylander. Welcome. Wings in when we're out in town, got it?
lines.ground: (cough) Welcome. Not a lot of humans stick their neck out for us. Means something.

lines.t: ...Hey.
I've been thinking about a name. How does SP sound?
The Sky Poopers.
Close. The Sky Patrol. We patrol our kind and stop the Sky Haters.
lines.ground: Close. The Sky Patrol. We keep Skylanders safe from the Sky Haters - and you're part of that now.

lines.t: (Worried) Guys! I think there's a Skylander being attacked down there!
Oh snap, let's get it!
Y'all can handle that one. I've got research to do. {You}, go with them.
lines.group: Y'all can handle that one. I've got research to do. Go with them.

steps.obj: Save the Skylander from the Sky Haters

escape_lines.t: Skyhater? Hahaha, no. I'm with the Sky Rebellion. We capture Royal Skylanders.
Running up and attacking was your only plan? Here - have a portal!
I'm here now. ...Where are Sam and Lexy?!

lines.t: Thank you... my wings wouldn't work in that fire.
No oxygen, no flying. Breath training fixes that.
That guy said he was a fallen Skylander. Like me.
He opened the portal for me before he ran. Sam's on the other side. We're getting him back.
*nods*

missions.title: Through the Portal
missions.desc: Follow Rhalix into the Sky Rebellion's hideout.

lines.t: Captain! Is that you?!
Where's Lexy?
They took her as soon as you got here. ...Captain, is it true? You're a fallen Skylander?
...Yeah. Back in my old world I was banished. Sorry I didn't say.
It's cool. We've only been a team a day, but it feels like forever.
lines.sky: It's cool. Skylanders stick together - right, {you}?

lines.t: Right.
Let's get back and plan. Tomorrow we save Lexy.

missions.title: Two Weeks of Training
missions.desc: Max is still tracking Lexy. Rhalix uses the time to train the team.

lines.t: Max, got anything on Lexy yet? It's been two weeks!
Don't rush him. You, Sam and {you} - training. Now.
lines.group: Don't rush him. Sam, and all of you - training. Now.

lines.t: Karma isn't just for hitting. Feel it, push it out, control it.

steps.obj: Training: knock out the sparring targets

lines.t: Haha! I'm gonna be vice captain first, watch.
You're on a good track. Both of you.
lines.group: You're on a good track. All of you.

lines.t: (radio) Got her location! ...Some place called Aurora.

missions.title: Kyrie's Questions
missions.desc: Kyrie wakes up. Then the team splits up.

lines.t: Me, a Royal, calling a fallen Skylander 'captain'? Don't make me laugh.
He saved your life!
It's fine. Kyrie - what do you know about the Sky Rebellion?
They took 70% of the Royal Capital. They sold our secrets to the Government for money.
The Government offered smartphones to the Royals only. The underclass got nothing. That started a war.
Aurora... in my world, people there were turned into demons. They might be making Lexy a demon Skylander.
I'm going to Aurora. Sam, Max - protect Kyrie.
Protect me? Unless you can dress like Royals and sneak me home, I'm leaving.
...A stealth mission doesn't sound bad.

choice.text: Go with Sam and Max to the Royal Capital.

reply.t: Then you're getting dressed up too.
reply.group: Then all of you are getting dressed up.

escape_lines.t: Salt on your wings!! ...Huh? Why isn't it working?
Salt? Who told you salt does anything to Skylanders?
Max said that was your weakness!
Sounds like Max lied to your ass. My team's got me.
Too late anyway. Come in, newcomer!
Captain... I'm scared... Lexy? No. She's gone.

steps.obj: Get through the Royal Capital (in disguise)

lines.t: (Girl voice) Hi, I'm Samantha! ...Where did Kyrie go?!
She flew off. Captain's about to be so upset. Hang on to your... everything.
...This outfit itches.

missions.title: Kyrie (Ava)
missions.desc: The SR got to Kyrie first. Up on the sky island, something is wrong with her.

lines.t: Kyrie! Wake up, we're here to take you back.
The Skylander Kyrie is long gone. And you, Max - traitors to the SR die.
I was going to join the Rebellion... then I realized I couldn't betray my team.
Max?! ...Fine. Vice captain, let's save Kyrie!

steps.obj: Stop Kyrie (Ava) without hurting Kyrie too much

lines.t: Only Kyrie can break free. Come on, Kyrie!
I'm NOT letting you take my body!!!
Impossible... she pulled me out! This is all Logan's fault!
Kishi!
And so Ava fell. Max, thrown from the island, was caught by Rhalix on his way up.
SR took my mom. I'll handle the Capital. Go save Lexy.
Oh, and the Capital's SR-free. I knocked out every traitor on my way in.
You wiped out thousands of soldiers AND fought Ava??
...Also, why are you two dressed like girls?

missions.title: A New Hideout
missions.desc: Kyrie paid the SP 70,000. Time for a new hideout - if the Sky Haters let you.

lines.t: Kyrie sent a payment. 70,000, Captain.
DAMN. That's a fire hideout.
...Sam. Since you asked. My real name might be Sintrie. I forgot it, five years ago.
lines.sky: ...Sam, {you}. Since you're Skylanders too - my real name might be Sintrie. I forgot it, five years ago.

lines.t: We'll help you find it. Promise.
Wait - who are THEY?

steps.obj: Beat the Sky Haters breaking in

missions.title: The Xeno Warriors Reunite
missions.desc: A government weapon is heading for the Mountain Village. Rhalix goes to find Mikiko.

lines.t: T.V. Man: The weapon is making its way to the Mountain Village. Run as soon as you can!
The Mountain Village... that's where Mikiko lives!
We've got the new hideout handled. Go. Take {you}.
lines.group: We've got the new hideout handled. Go. Take them with you.

steps.obj: Help Mikiko against the Corrupted Souls

lines.t: Don't worry Mikiko, I got your back!
I was waiting for you to jump in! ...Who's this?
Sky Patrol's newest. They've been holding it down.
lines.group: Sky Patrol's newest. All of them. They've been holding it down.

lines.t: Nice. Any friend of Rhalix. Now - Xeno Warrior reunion battle?
Winner's the leader.
...and then a Government car pulled up. But that's another story.
